ideas.title: The plughole
ideas.critique: The third session in a row on word-sand, and creatures riding down sand to a splash is close to the sledding gag. What's strong is a rotating flow field that carries the heightfield and the bodies on it, a new way things move, if the spiral really moves and isn't just an animated sink.

ideas.title: Sweep it into the sea
ideas.critique: Lumi against the friends' crowd for a meadow score repeats the balancing game's recipe on the same sand. Sand that piles up in front of the broom and gets heavier is real material play, and that is the only part that is new.

ideas.title: A friend made of mirror
ideas.critique: One more species, and friends gathering to look at themselves has the same payoff as the TV set. A curved chrome body reflecting the whole island is a real path tracer showpiece, but the reactions are scripted one-liners you have seen before.

ideas.title: Gold under the meadow
ideas.critique: Creatures reshape the ground again, this time with holes instead of dunes, and a crowd rush is the same recipe. Cutting real holes into the mesh that fill with rain is the new part, but the pitch makes it a backdrop.

ideas.title: Marble rain
ideas.critique: Falling, rolling, bouncing things are an example the goals already name, so it will read as expected. Thousands of glass beads pooling in hollows and friends skating on them is very watchable and good material for a path tracer.

ideas.title: The island dreams
ideas.critique: Miniature scenes floating over friends are another scripted picture overhead, like the cloud shapes and the little island at sea, and every dream is a pun you could guess. Nothing in it moves or plays differently from before.

ideas.title: Whirlwind
ideas.critique: Friends chasing a roaming thing echoes the moth, and roaming zones have been done. A vortex that physically lifts and drops props and bodies is new physics the island lacks, and leaving things scattered gives a reason to watch again.

ideas.title: Shadow theatre
ideas.critique: A Lumi-led set piece where friends perform and something goes comically wrong is a known shape. Shadows that disobey their casters is a real twist, but faking them separately undercuts the path traced soft shadows it claims to show off.

ideas.title: Echo from the sea
ideas.critique: Words coming back garbled is the mishearing payoff of the word chain again. Sound is something the island barely has, and if the echo really answers it is more than subtitles, but the plain version is one more joke in text bubbles.

ideas.title: Glass the dunes
ideas.critique: It builds on the word-sand again and ends as a still-life of sculptures to look at, not to play with. Branching glass grown from strikes, with sun shining through the caustics, is exactly what a path tracer can do and a raster game cannot.
